registered_by: S3 build worker (PM design tolerances supplied in the S3 brief + architecture gate doc)
measured_evidence: none. These are precision-derived DESIGN BOUNDS registered before any live capture. No S0/S1/S2 measurement was used to pick them, and none may be used to widen them after a failure.
precedent_note: configs/evaluation_protocol.json leaves the numeric parity tolerance deliberately null ('pending'); this file fills that slot for the terminal-feature capture only. The S1 quality/parity slots are unaffected.

applies_to: prompt token count / prompt_len / terminal position / query range
shard/record sha256, archive checksums, byte sizes
metadata.note: Integers, ids and hashes must match bit-for-bit. Any mismatch is a hard failure and must be reported as a mis-association, never averaged or retried away.

bf16_gemm_vs_runtime_selected_logits.applies_to: offline BF16 emulation of the 24 verbalizer rows (vector_bf16 x lm_head rows, bf16 operands, fp32 accumulate) vs the RAW runtime logits captured at the same rows
bf16_gemm_vs_runtime_selected_logits.ulp_bf16_definition: ulp_bf16(x) = 2 ** (floor(log2(|x|)) - 7) for finite non-zero x, else 0. BF16 has 1 sign + 8 exponent + 7 explicit mantissa bits (8 significant bits), so consecutive representable values inside [2**e, 2**(e+1)) differ by 2**(e-7).
bf16_gemm_vs_runtime_selected_logits.why_two_ulps: one ULP covers the bf16 rounding of the GEMM result, the second covers the rounding of the head-row operands participating in the accumulation that reaches the selected logit. This is a bound on the rounding of the compared quantities, not a claim about GEMM accumulation order.
bf16_gemm_vs_runtime_selected_logits.why_floor: near logit 0 the pure ULP bound collapses towards 0 and becomes an unreachably tight rather than physically motivated bound; 1e-4 is the registered floor.
bf16_gemm_vs_runtime_selected_logits.scope_limit: This class is emulation-based (numpy, no GPU). It bounds rounding only; it does not validate the real Marlin/FP8/BF16 kernel path, and the offline emulation cannot prove hardware behaviour.

fp32_direct_head_offline_vs_online.applies_to: offline FP32 readout (vector_fp32 x effective fp32 rows, fp32 accumulate) vs the RAW runtime logits at the same 24 rows
fp32_direct_head_offline_vs_online.scope_limit: The runtime head is BF16, so this class can only pass if the comparison is done on a vector whose BF16 rounding is already applied (vector_bf16 -> fp32). A failure here is evidence of a row-ownership/scaling error, not of precision.

base_restricted_probability.applies_to: softmax over the 24 masked base-token logits (runtime logits -> probabilities) vs the offline reconstruction of the same restricted distribution
base_restricted_probability.operator: abs(p_offline - p_runtime) <= 0.005 for every active slot
base_restricted_probability.note: Absolute, not relative: probabilities near 0 have no meaningful relative bound.

inactive_slots.policy: slots outside the active primitive must be EXACTLY 0.0 after masking; any non-zero inactive slot fails the gate

masked_probability_sum_fp32.applies_to: sum of the active masked probabilities computed in FP32

row_scaling_and_softcap.applies_to: output-head scale and logit soft-cap read from the live LogitsProcessor
row_scaling_and_softcap.policy: if the effective row scaling or a non-None soft-cap cannot be reproduced from the recorded LogitsProcessor values, the parity gate STOPS (no comparison is reported) instead of comparing under an unknown transform

evaluate_without_widening.rule: Tolerances are frozen before the first live comparison. A failure is reported as a failure.
permitted_follow_up: Re-run the SAME comparison on a separate raw-logit repeat to measure run-to-run variation (recorded as a measurement, not as a tolerance).
Investigate the cause by kernel regime / batch shape / cache mode; fix the cause and re-run the same comparison.

If a class is later shown to be mis-specified (for example the soft-cap transform was missed), register a NEW versioned tolerance file with the reason and re-run everything under it; the old file is preserved.
not_permitted: Editing a numeric value in this file in response to a failed comparison.
Reporting a comparison as passing under a different class than the one registered for it.
evaluate_without_widening.on_failure_do_not: widen, average away, drop failing rows, or re-define which slots are active

repeat_measurement_policy.available: only if the live capture produced two records for the same prompt_token_sha256 (dup_disambiguation 0 and 1)
repeat_measurement_policy.report: max abs difference of the raw selected logits between repeats, per class, labelled as a MEASUREMENT
repeat_measurement_policy.absent: reported explicitly as 'no repeated raw-logit captures' - never substituted with a tolerance
